Name: Asenath
Summary: Asenath was the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, whom Pharaoh gave to Joseph as his wife. She bore him Manasseh and Ephraim.
KeyStory: Asenath became the mother of two tribes of Israel, born in Egypt before the famine's worst years.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Poti-pherah; Manasseh; Ephraim
LifeLesson: God can plant His people in the unlikeliest places — even Pharaoh's court.
